title: WaterColor "Great Blue Heron" 44 Crossvine Circle
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per WaterColor Community guidelines the maximum number of wristbands this home is allotted is 10 bands to access WaterColor amenities and community pools- Private pool and sitting spa *Pool heating is available from January 1st through April 30th for an additional fee of $40 per day.- Located in the beautiful Camp district of WaterColor- Surrounded by natural green space and parks- Steps away from Camp WaterColor & Wood Fern Park- 5 adult bikes provided- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and a third pool with zero-entry, as well as an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Welcome to Great Blue Heron, a 5-bedroom, 5-bathroom WaterColor home that sleeps 10. Experience nearby Camp WaterColor and Wood Fern Park alongside all the amenities this premier Gulf community offers—kayaking, private beaches, biking trails, and more! Guests will love this 3-story home’s private pool and multiple sunlit porches.Pale wood floors seamlessly connect the combined living, dining, and kitchen areas on the first floor—all featuring neutral colors and refined décor. The living area’s 2 plush couches and matching chairs beckon for a peaceful evening in front of the 50” TV. In the kitchen, cooking is a dream with Jenn-Air appliances and a gorgeous island with plenty of space for preparing delicious meals and seating for 4. A wooden 8-person dining table sits under a minimalist chandelier for an elegant evening meal. Outside, indulge in sun-soaked luxury by the sitting spa and private pool. Fire up the propane grill and dine alfresco at the 8-person table on the screened-in porch before relaxing post-meal by the outdoor fireplace. Guests can retire to the primary bedroom with a king bed and private porch that overlooks the pool. For additional sleeping accommodations, there is a bunk room with a queen-over-queen bunk bed on this level and more guest bedrooms upstairs.Head up to the second floor to find a sitting area with a couch, 45” TV, and wet bar—perfect for teens or as an alternate hangout spot. Grab the Summer’s bestseller and curl up on the spacious balcony’s bed swing or sip a refreshing glass of iced tea at the 4-person table. There are 2 guest bedrooms with king beds and a primary bedroom with a king bed and private balcony on this floor—all have Smart TVs.A guest bedroom with a king bed is on the top floor.Great Blue Heron’s private pool and convenient location make it the ultimate WaterColor getaway. Leisurely explore the area on the provided 5 adult bikes and enjoy parking for 3 vehicles. Guests can choose between private beach access at WaterColor Beach Club or public access in Van Ness Butler and Santa Clara. Book this Gulf home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 10):FIRST FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyBunk Room: Queen-over-Queen Bunk BedSECOND FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: King, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: King, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to fines.
